Attribute.notes: Its own envelope with root <Attribute>. The index materializes idBasedOn for Domain (attribute_idbasedon_domain rule; also object_idbasedon_domain on Procedure/SDT/WebPanel/etc.) and resolvable calls in Property Formula for Procedure, WebPanel and DataProvider (same effective-Source patterns); it does not cover the expression's full semantics nor domain functions not mapped as a local object. who-uses(Domain) counts based_on_domain from any origin in scope, not only Attribute.

BusinessProcessDiagram.notes: GXflow Business Process Diagram. Identified from the XPZ Dependencies block (type name 'Business Process Diagram', package GxpmBL) of a public GXflow sample; GeneXus wiki page 7273. The diagram Part carries declarative task bindings to other objects (PWFTask* properties) and condition expressions. queryableByKbIntelligence=false: the index does not extract those bindings, and the type is counted in the coverage of reverse-relation answers; use object-info and an XML read.

CategoryDiagram.notes: Category or organizational diagram exported by the KB.

ColorPalette.notes: Color palette (Part; current extractor does not generate edges). queryableByKbIntelligence=false.

Dashboard.notes: Composite visual panel (Part; current extractor does not generate edges). queryableByKbIntelligence=false.

DataView.notes: GeneXus Data View (external table; Part with DataViewAttribute and DataViewStructurePlatform).

DataStore.notes: GeneXus Datastore (Properties only in the export; no relation extractor in the current index). queryableByKbIntelligence=false: do not use who-uses/what-uses/impact-basic/functional-trace-basic; use object-info, search-objects or list-by-type.

DeploymentUnit.notes: Deployment unit (Part; current extractor does not generate edges). queryableByKbIntelligence=false.

DesignSystem.notes: Design system (Part; current extractor does not generate edges). queryableByKbIntelligence=false.

Document.notes: GeneXus document (Part; current extractor does not generate edges). queryableByKbIntelligence=false.

ExternalObject.notes: External Object. The index materializes a declarative reference via ATTCUSTOMTYPE exo:<Name> and effective use via a method call on a variable typed as exo:<Name> in the effective Source.

File.notes: GeneXus file (Part; current extractor does not generate edges). queryableByKbIntelligence=false.

Folder.notes: Container created by the user (Properties only; ...0008). queryableByKbIntelligence=false: the index's semantic queries do not model folder dependency; use object-info or parent navigation in the XML.

K2BEntityServices.notes: Instance of the K2BTools addon's Entity Services pattern (EntityTypeNamespace K2BTools). queryableByKbIntelligence=false: current extractor does not guarantee semantic edges; do not use who-uses/what-uses/impact-basic/functional-trace-basic. Use object-info, search-objects or list-by-type.

K2BGeneralSettings.notes: Global configuration of the K2BTools addon. queryableByKbIntelligence=false: current engine does not extract relations; do not use who-uses/what-uses/impact-basic/functional-trace-basic. Use object-info, search-objects or list-by-type.

K2BMenu.notes: Application menu of the K2BTools addon. queryableByKbIntelligence=false: current extractor does not guarantee semantic edges; do not use who-uses/what-uses/impact-basic/functional-trace-basic.

K2BPrompt.notes: Prompt/selection of the K2BTools addon. queryableByKbIntelligence=false: current extractor does not guarantee semantic edges; do not use who-uses/what-uses/impact-basic/functional-trace-basic.

K2BTrnForm.notes: Transaction Web Form generated by the K2BTools pattern (K2BTrnForm). queryableByKbIntelligence=false: current extractor does not guarantee semantic edges; do not use who-uses/what-uses/impact-basic/functional-trace-basic.

Language.notes: Language (Part; current extractor does not generate edges). queryableByKbIntelligence=false.

Menubar.notes: Menu Bar / Menubar (Win generators: VB/Java Win/VFP). Deprecated since GeneXus 15 (Menu Bar wiki). Leftover in converted KBs (e.g. BbInfo description MICRO Info). queryableByKbIntelligence=false: current extractor does not guarantee semantic edges; do not use who-uses/what-uses/impact-basic/functional-trace-basic. Distinct from the Native Mobile Menu object and from K2BMenu (K2BTools addon).

Module.notes: System container (Part; extractor does not model module dependency). queryableByKbIntelligence=false.

OfflineDatabase.notes: Offline Database object of an offline Smart Devices application. Identified from the XPZ Dependencies block (type name 'Offline Database', package GenexusBL) of a public offline sample; GeneXus wiki page 22509. It has events (e.g. Start) that can call other objects. queryableByKbIntelligence=false: the index does not extract those calls, and the type is counted in the coverage of reverse-relation answers; use object-info and an XML read.

PackagedModule.notes: Packaged module (Part; extractor does not model dependency). queryableByKbIntelligence=false.

RootModule.notes: Virtual root of the KB; has no XML materialized in KbObjectsXml. Objects parented to this root show 'Module/Folder: Root Module' in the IDE.

Panel.notes: GeneXus Panel (Part). Since extractor 23 its Smart Devices pattern instance gives panel_references_attribute relations (layouts, orders, search, break by, filters), listed in who-uses of an Attribute; no calls and no based_on_domain edges (outside IDBASEDON_DOMAIN_SOURCE_TYPES). queryableByKbIntelligence=false: it is not accepted as the queried object.

PatternSettings.notes: Global Pattern configuration (Part with Data/CDATA; current extractor does not parse it). queryableByKbIntelligence=false: do not use who-uses/what-uses/impact-basic/functional-trace-basic.

Query.notes: GeneXus Query object (QueryElement, filters, parameters, chart/card settings).

SDPanelDesigner.notes: Settings object of the K2BTools addon's SD designer (EntityType SDPanelDesigner; typically SDPanelDesignerSettings). queryableByKbIntelligence=false: current engine does not extract relations; do not use who-uses/what-uses/impact-basic/functional-trace-basic.

SmartDevicesApplication.notes: Smart Devices application (SmartDevicesPlus / WWPM addon); Part Dashboard and Source; distinct from the catalog's Dashboard type. queryableByKbIntelligence=false: the current extractor does not read its Source, so it produces no call relations (empty graphs are misleading); use object-info and an XML read.

SmartDevicesPlus.notes: Global configuration of the Smart Devices Plus addon (Properties under Object; SDPlus_Settings_*); typical parent RootModule. queryableByKbIntelligence=false: current engine does not extract relations; do not use who-uses/what-uses/impact-basic/functional-trace-basic (empty graphs are misleading). Use object-info, search-objects or list-by-type.

SubTypeGroup.notes: SubTypeGroup (Part; current extractor does not generate edges). queryableByKbIntelligence=false.

Theme.notes: Theme (Part; extractor does not model the Theme/ThemeClass graph). queryableByKbIntelligence=false.

ThemeClass.notes: Theme class (Properties only in the export). queryableByKbIntelligence=false: the index's graph does not model references to ThemeClass; use object-info or XML/theme.

ThemeColor.notes: Theme color (Properties only in the export). queryableByKbIntelligence=false: current engine does not extract relations.

ThemeTransformation.notes: Theme Transformation (Properties only in the export, e.g. ThemeElementThemeTypes). UserControl.notes: User control (Part; current extractor does not generate edges). queryableByKbIntelligence=false.

WebPanelDesigner.notes: Settings object of the K2BTools addon's Web designer (EntityType WebPanelDesigner; typically WebPanelDesignerSettings). Distinct from the internal FormDesignerPart in the KB's SQL. queryableByKbIntelligence=false: current engine does not extract relations; do not use who-uses/what-uses/impact-basic/functional-trace-basic.

WorkPanel.notes: Legacy GeneXus Work Panel (deprecated since GeneXus 15); Form Type=Windows. Since extractor 20 the index reads its code like a WebPanel's: calls from a classic one's Rules and Events and from a modern one's effective Source, attribute uses from its Rules and Events, and since extractor 21 from its Conditions; attribute uses in its Windows form are not read. Calls to it are read from classic call(W...) and modern <WorkPanel>.Call(...) and call(<WorkPanel>, ...).

WorkWith.notes: WW for SD/mobile. Current name: Work With. Historical name: Work With for Smart Devices. Historical Pattern names do not define the type; always classify by GUID. queryableByKbIntelligence=false: the WorkWithForWeb action/link extractors match only the web Work With XML shape, so mobile Work With calls produce no relations (empty graphs are misleading); use object-info and an XML read.

WorkWithForWeb.notes: WW for Web per transaction. Historical Pattern names can be ambiguous, including appearing as WorkWith; always classify by GUID. Task Export accepts WorkWith in -ObjectList; see 10a-gx-export-task-labels.md.

WorkWithPlusInstance.notes: Instance of the WorkWithPlus Pattern (third-party) applied to a GeneXus object, typically WebPanel.

WorkflowDocument.notes: GXflow workflow document (Properties only in the export, e.g. PWFDocType). Identified from the XPZ Dependencies block (type name 'WorkflowDocument', package GxpmBL) of a public GXflow sample; GeneXus training material 'Working with documents'. Not the knowledge-base Document type (faeb588c-...). queryableByKbIntelligence=false: current engine does not extract relations.

WorkflowRole.notes: GXflow role (Properties only in the export). Identified from the XPZ Dependencies block (type name 'Role', package GxpmBL) of a public GXflow sample; GeneXus wiki page 10194. Named WorkflowRole so it is not confused with GAM roles. queryableByKbIntelligence=false: current engine does not extract relations.
